incidents.summary: Bulk SKU rename batch of 79 SKUs across 35 "phantom" products treated status=archived/draft/unlisted as phantom-eligible. Live BXGY discounts, FOTM Free Packet flow, Stay.ai bundles, donation upsell, and ~19 active free-item / GWP / Mystery Gift / gift-box products broke. incidents.rootCause: AgentSmith dispatched the cleanup with insufficient safety thinking. CatalogSmith's phantom signal (duplicate-SKU + non-active-status) inverts reality at Teeccino, where status=archived/draft/unlisted is the canonical hidden-but-active state for cart-addable products. Single safety guard (skip status=active) caught 48/83 entries; the remaining 35 included ~19 active products. Free Java Packet 7976160755960 — explicitly named in Shopkeeper CLAUDE.md as the FOTM Free Packet — got renamed despite being a hard-rule ID, because the hard-rule was in markdown text, not in a machine-readable refuse-list.
